headline: CrowdStrike to Acquire Zscaler in $44 Billion All-Stock Deal
summary: CrowdStrike announced an all-stock transaction valued at approximately $44 billion to acquire cloud security company Zscaler, combining two of the largest providers in the cybersecurity industry.
why: Consolidation between premier endpoint and cloud security providers creates one of the biggest pure-play cybersecurity platforms in the enterprise software sector.

impacts.name: CrowdStrike
impacts.why: CrowdStrike is issuing equity to fund the $44B acquisition of cloud-security rival Zscaler.
